description: Pro. Finds parcels near a Texas address or coordinate that suit a warehouse or manufacturing building: acres in a range, a minimum share of ground under 5 percent slope (USGS 3DEP), and a limit on FEMA 100-year floodplain. Returns location, acres, flat share, floodplain acres and buildable acres after 50 ft setbacks and easements. No owner names here. Not about power: use it when someone wants to build on dirt. Then open Plan on the parcel to lay out the pad, cut and fill, parking, costs and permits.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

max_flood_pct.description: Maximum share in the FEMA 100-year floodplain. Default 30.

min_flat_pct.description: Minimum share of the parcel under 5 percent slope. Default 60.

radius_mi.description: Search radius in miles, 1 to 10. Default 10.

name: find_building_land
title: Find land for an industrial building near a point
